content.title: Playground
description: Today's schools are not only tasked with preparing children for their future careers, but also teaching essential life skills, habits and attitudes that will help them successfully navigate adulthood. To do this and provide the best learning experience for students requires both indoor instruction and outdoor physical activity.

While kids explore school playgrounds they are building important life skills that will eventually help children become effective thinkers, leaders and collaborators. Unfortunately, play is under scrutiny as school administrators, teachers and parents feel pressure for children to "perform" academically and spend more time in classroom instruction. And with the prevalence of electronics and the amount of screen time children are receiving each day, recess and free play on a playground are more important than ever.

By creating an environment where children can experience unstructured play, you're not only supporting their physical health but also increasing their chances to succeed in the classroom. Kids pay more attention to academic tasks when they are given frequent, brief opportunities for free play. Recess can also have a calming effect helping with disciplinary issues and impulse control.
Unstructured physical activity on the playground helps kids become smarter, healthier and stronger.

content.title: Curriculum
description: Indian Public School is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education. The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) established in the year 1929, enjoys today the distinction of being one of the oldest and largest Board of Secondary Education in India. It has about 15,000 affiliated schools in India and across 24 other countries of the world. The CBSE affiliated schools follow a uniform curriculum with a flexible scheme of studies suitable to the needs of each and every student. Notwithstanding the geographical variations, the schools and students under CBSE enjoy and share common privileges as regards the curriculum, examinations and academic innovations.

The CBSE envisions a robust, vibrant and holistic school education that will engender excellence in every sphere of human endeavour. The Board is committed to provide quality education to promote intellectual, social and cultural vivacity among its learners. It works towards evolving a learning process and environment, which empowers the future citizens to become global leaders in the emerging knowledge society. The Board advocates Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation with an emphasis on holistic development of learners. The Board commits itself to provide a stress-free learning environment that will develop competent, confident and enterprising citizens who will promote harmony and peace.

content.title: Admission Policy
description: The admission process generally begins in the month of November/ December. Admission is open to students of all communities, irrespective of caste & creed. The registration form is valid for one academic year only. The registration fee is non-refundable. Age-appropriate observations/aptitude test is administered to identify the basic skills of a child in Language/Math/ Science etc. These tests are administered to help the child and parent and in turn for the school to understand the child’s needs. In case of cancellation of admission, admission fee and school fee will not be refunded. An incomplete Registration Form will be rejected without assigning any reason.

Admission opens to all the students irrespective of religion, race, caste, creed or place of birth.

content.title: Competition @ 365 Days
description: Competition in any form brings out the best in people and pushes them to excel. In schools, if used effectively, it can enhance learning significantly.

Certainly, competition in the classroom is quite healthy; it should, in fact, be encouraged. It allows students to extend themselves, to exploit their real capabilities and maximize their true potential. It is most productive when it occurs among students of similar abilities.

Traditionally, schools have fostered competition among students by assigning positions at the end of the term/semester. Each student is assigned a position based on the average score obtained from an aggregate of tests and assignment scores. In fact, some schools give positions by subject as well as overall class position so a student may have come in the third position, but might have gained first place in Math.

Usually, the diligent student is concerned about the position that he/she acquires and no good student wants to move from a high position in the class, to a lower one. This keeps competition alive and well in the classroom. Students are able to match their abilities against that of their classmates and easily determine who their rivals are. In other words, they evaluate their own competencies and recognize who their competitors are.They can then decide how much effort they need to put into their work in order to remain at the top. Over time, they might also acknowledge that there are certain students whom they cannot match and to whom they must concede defeat.

Today's schools are not only tasked with preparing children for their future careers, but also teaching essential life skills, habits and attitudes that will help them successfully navigate adulthood.

To provide the best learning experience for students, schools need to balance indoor instruction with outdoor physical activity. Playgrounds provide children with an environment where they can learn, interact, explore and stay physically active.

Why Play Matters

Play Builds Strong Foundations

With increasing academic pressure and the prevalence of electronics, recess and free play on a playground are more important than ever.

Better Focus

Frequent opportunities for free play can help children pay better attention to academic tasks.

Healthy & Strong

Outdoor physical activity supports children's physical health and encourages an active lifestyle.

Social Skills

Playground activities encourage collaboration, communication, leadership and positive interaction among students.

Outdoor Experience

A Space to Explore & Grow

By creating an environment where children can experience unstructured play, schools can support physical health while creating positive opportunities for classroom learning.

Recess can also have a calming effect, helping children develop better impulse control and supporting positive behaviour.

Spacious campus grounds provide students with opportunities for outdoor activities, recreation and physical development.

CBSE Affiliated Structured & Holistic Education
Our Academic Framework

Learning with Purpose

Indian Public School is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) .

The Central Board of Secondary Education, established in 1929, enjoys the distinction of being one of the oldest and largest Boards of Secondary Education in India. It has about 15,000 affiliated schools in India and across 24 other countries of the world.

CBSE affiliated schools follow a uniform curriculum with a flexible scheme of studies suitable to the needs of each and every student. Not with the standing geographical variations, the schools and students under CBSE enjoy and share common privileges are regards the curriculum, examinations, and academic innovations.

Education Beyond the Classroom

The CBSE envisions a robust, vibrant and holistic school education that will engender excellence in every sphere of human endeavour. The Board is committed to providing quality education to promote intellectual, social and cultural vivacity among its learners.

It works towards evolving a learning process and environment which empowers future citizens to become global leaders in the emerging knowledge society. The board advocates continuous and comprehensive evaluation with an emphasis on holistic development of learners. The board commits itself to provide a stress-free learning environment that will develop competent, confident and enterprising citizens who will promote harmony and peace.

Learning Based Activity

The old-school model of passively learning facts and reciting them out of context is no longer sufficient to prepare students to survive in today's world. Solving highly complex problems requires that students have both fundamental skills (reading, writing, and math) and 21st century skills (teamwork, problem-solving, research gathering, time management, information synthesizing, utilizing high tech tools). With this combination of skills, students become directors and managers of their learning process, guided and mentored by a skilled teacher. We at IPS ensures that students are kept at the centre of the entire learning process and all the teaching activities like examinations, workshops, projects, assignments must revolve around him to ensure vertical and 360-degree development of the child.

Career Guidance cell


The Career information and guidance department at IPS is committed towards providing an effective platform to students to enable them to make informed decisions about their future. It provides leadership in the development and implementation of a comprehensive career education program that promotes knowledge of careers and all types of employment opportunities and that emphasizes to students the advantages of completing school with marketable skills. The School's career guidance program is based on the principles of self-development, career exploration and career management. The department provides professional guidance which is informative and most importantly tailored to each and every student's talents and aptitudes.

This preparation starts from class IX culminating beyond class Xll when the students seek, apply and attain admissions in various universities in India. The sessions help create awareness regarding various career paths beyond the conventional ones after identifying suitable courses with the help of aptitude tests and interactions. Emphasis is laid on providing each and every student the advice and guidance which is appropriate and relevant to his or her individual interests and abilities. The department works towards fostering a positive partnership between the school and each student, of course supported by the parents. The child is encouraged to use the school's resources and maximize the opportunities available in the realm of higher studies (both in India and abroad).

The Career Information and Guidance Department provides assistance in the following areas:

Information about various career options in Robotics, Avionics, Banking, IT, AI and many emerging fields.

Psychometric Analysis of student  to gauge their inherent potentials . 

Supports and administers University applications-making transcripts, recommendation letters predicted grades and the School profile.

Corresponds and follows-up with universities regarding student’s applications.

Arrange talks by university representatives and other eminent experts. Internship in the corporate sector to sensitize to the atmosphere, demands, skills and expectations of a work place.

pages.textContent:
Competition @ 365 Days

Competition in any form brings out the best in people and pushes them to excel. In schools, if used effectively, it can enhance learning significantly.

Certainly, competition in the classroom is quite healthy; it should, in fact, be encouraged. It allows students to extend themselves, to exploit their real capabilities and maximize their true potential. It is most productive when it occurs among students of similar abilities.

Traditionally, schools have fostered competition among students by assigning positions at the end of the term/semester. Each student is assigned a position based on the average score obtained from an aggregate of tests and assignment scores. In fact, some schools give positions by subject as well as overall class position so a student may have come in the third position, but might have gained first place in Math.

Usually, the diligent student is concerned about the position that he/she acquires and no good student wants to move from a high position in the class, to a lower one. This keeps competition alive and well in the classroom. Students are able to match their abilities against that of their classmates and easily determine who their rivals are. In other words, they evaluate their own competencies and recognize who their competitors are.They can then decide how much effort they need to put into their work in order to remain at the top. Over time, they might also acknowledge that there are certain students whom they cannot match and to whom they must concede defeat.

How To Prepare For 12th Board Exams In 1 Month?

Date: 02-Nov-2021

All students must know Class 12 boards are crucial to crack if you want to do well in your entrance exams. This marks the beginning of your journey towards your dream college. Let’s take a detailed look at your 1-month study plan if you want to know how to prepare CBSE board exam in one month.

Given below is a sample timetable to finish the whole syllabus and prepare for the exam in 30 days.

Days Subjects
1-5 Physics – Keep the complete list of formulae, experiments, and derivations.
6-9 Chemistry – Questions related to organic and inorganic chemistry are fact-based questions that can be solved quickly with good practice.
10-15 Maths – Firstly, clear the basic fundamentals and concepts of the subject. Some calculations can be lengthy so you should practice a lot of these types of questions.
16-18 English – Read as much as you can. Any piece of good literature should not escape your hands: Your textbooks, the newspaper, or anything else you can lay your hands on. Follow a good grammar book and know the basic rules.
19-22 Biology/Computer Science – The key to a successful Computer Science or Biology exam is understanding. Be Thorough with the diagrams and important terminologies.
23-27 Revision days as per subjects. Dedicate each day per subject.
27-30 Solve sample or previous years papers

Create a schedule for one subject at a time. You could modify it as per your preferences. Try and set a specific time to study every day and you’ll find that it makes things so much easier. Remember that the grades you get in the 12th board exams do matter and they determine, to a large extent, your career graph.

All the best.

About Indian Public School

School Establishment

Discover the foundation, vision and learning environment that define Indian Public School, Sambalpur.

Established

2009

2nd April

Indian Public School was established on 2nd April, 2009 under The KS Dalmia Education Trust.

The school has credo towards character building and all-round personality development covering areas of intellectual stimulations, physical robustness, social adaptability, emotional independence, in-depth knowledge of subjects, fluency and good communication skills, confidence building and leadership qualities.

A Complete Learning Environment

The School is spread over 7 acres of land, the school is equipped with facilities comparable with the best in the country, both in academics and extra-curricular activities. It is these 'extras' that will make your child's education complete.

Indian Public School, Sambalpur

Indian Public School- Best Residential School in Sambalpur. The school has strength of 1000+ students and classes from Pre Primary level up to Class XII. There are more than 50 teachers around 25 other staff members and an enviable state-of-the-art infrastructure.

IPS is affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary Education (C.B.S.E.), New Delhi.

A Legacy of Excellence

Indian Public School, Sambalpur is an epitome of dignity, pride, values and a recognized landmark in its pursuit of excellence in education and holistic development. IPS has maintained a proud legacy of excellence offering super co-educational institution offering world-class infrastructural and education facilities and learning experience.

IPS is deeply dedicated in building "World Leaders Of Tomorrow" . Indian Public School offers a compelling combination of small classes, caring faculty, academic rigor and strong spiritual values.

Beyond Classroom Learning

Indian Public School caters to the ever expansive 'Indian Middle Class' which is looking at ensuring its child with the best in education and other activities.

The school focuses on providing and delivering not just classroom based learning but also outside classroom activities. Students are encouraged to take part in national and international events of various kinds ranging from academics to cultural to sport.

Learning as an Experience

Indian Public School aspires to make learning an experience. Where every child learns in an environment of joy and motivation - one that nourishes latent talents & develops full potential. IPS is unique for the quality of education that it imparts to students and its dedication towards their success.

pages.textContent:
WELCOME TO IPS

Begin a Journey of Experiential Learning

Indian Public School is a group of people passionate about making learning experiential & lifelong. The trained teachers team love teaching & work hard every day to give your child holistic learning. Our aim is to inspire a quest for learning in your child.

Indian Public School is a pioneer in the field of education, introducing new generation learning in Sambalpur.


SIMPLE & TRANSPARENT PROCESS

Your Admission Journey at IPS

Follow these simple steps to become a part of the Indian Public School family.

1. Visit the School Campus

Visiting the school campus is an important step in selecting the right school for your child. Our Parent Advisor & Admission Counselor plan your tour to ensure you get the maximum value from your visit.

2. Submit Application Form

Fill in the application form and submit it along with the required documents.

3. Observation

After submitting the application form, we will schedule an 'Observation' for your child. This helps us understand their learning skills and readiness for the respective class.

4. Admission

Upon successful completion of the observation step, you will need to deposit the term fee to complete the admission process and officially join the IPS family.

5. Post Admission

Starting at a new school is a big change. We conduct a Parent Orientation Program to help you get acquainted with the school, meet the Principal, and connect with fellow parents.
